glosses: illocutionary (of, pertaining to, or derived from illocution)
zielgerichtet; auf ein kommunikatives Ziel ausgerichtet; die Absichten des Sprechers zum Ausdruck bringend

examples.text: Beim illokutionären Akt wird das Gesagte z.B. als Befehl, Behauptung, Rat, Warnung oder Versprechen verwendet.

glosses: Of, pertaining to, or deriving from illocution, the performance of acts by speaking.

examples.text: "I pronounce you man and wife" is a descriptive statement, but also has illocutionary force.

Derridean "messianicity without messianism" that marks so much of post-modernist educational theorizing today, and that makes use of esotericism, sigetics, acroamatics, proleptics, and illocutionary and perlocutionary acts in the disguise of a new pedagogy of the unknowable, wasn't the answer ten years ago.
